title: Topic 2.1: The Bible as a Guide

pages.lesson:
LESSON: THE BIBLE AS A GUIDE

Grade: Grade 5
Subject: CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
Strand: The Bible
Topic 2.1: The Bible as a Guide

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello! Today we learn about The Bible as a Guide. Read the explanation, study the examples, do the practice, then try the revision quiz.

Big question: Why should the Bible guide us in daily life?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. identify the benefits of reading the Bible

SECTION 3: LEARN STEP BY STEP

1. identify the benefits of reading the Bible
   In simple words: practise until you can identify the benefits of reading the Bible. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

SECTION 4: EXAMPLES

Example 1: Talk about The Bible as a Guide using something you see at school in Kenya.

Example 2: Give a home example from your county, estate, or village.

Example 3: Teach a younger child one idea from this lesson in simple words.

SECTION 5: TRY THIS

1. Underline two new ideas about The Bible as a Guide in the examples.
2. Explain The Bible as a Guide to a parent using one local example.
3. Draw or write three things that show you understand The Bible as a Guide.
4. Show that you can: identify the benefits of reading the Bible

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (PRACTICE & REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about The Bible as a Guide using examples from school or home.
2. Answer: Why is The Bible as a Guide important for a Grade 5 learner?
3. Make a one-minute oral presentation to a parent or teacher.
4. List three ways you will practise this topic this week.

SECTION 7: CLASS ACTIVITY IDEAS

1. List different uses of the Bible in society today,
2. Communication: writing skills are enhanced as learners write messages from the Bible on flash cards.
3. English: the skill of reading is applied as they read the Bible.

SECTION: REMEMBER

1. identify the benefits of reading the Bible

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open the Answers tab only after you finish.

— CBC Learn · Original learner lesson from KICD outcomes (Strategy 2)
